what_this_is: Software cross-implementation conformance vectors for Tango's score confidence interval. These are outputs of an independent third-party implementation, recorded so this repository's implementation can be checked against something other than itself.
what_this_is_not: NOT a reproduction of a primary-paper worked table: Tango (1998) Stat Med 17:891-908 is paywalled and no accessible worked values were found (searched 2026-08-06). NOT study evidence, NOT a model result, and NOT usable as any number in the write-up.

oracle.license: GPL-2 | GPL-3 - incompatible with this repository's Apache-2.0, so the package is used strictly as a black-box oracle; no PropCIs code is copied, translated, or vendored here
oracle.installed_into: an isolated temporary R library; no system or workspace R library was mutated
oracle.implements: Tango T. (1998) Statistics in Medicine 17:891-908, per the package's own citation

direction_convention: b = reference correct and candidate wrong; c = candidate correct and reference wrong. The interval is for candidate - reference, point estimate (c - b) / n. PropCIs uses the same orientation, verified by the sign of every asymmetric vector below.
agreement_tolerance: 1e-6. The oracle's own bisection stops at dp < 1e-7 or |z - score| < 1e-6, so its endpoints are accurate to about that; agreement is asserted at 1e-6 rather than claimed tighter than the oracle can support. This repository's implementation solves the score equation to ~1e-11 and is exactly symmetric under swapping b and c, which the oracle is not.
